mapper.insert: insert into teachers (user_id, teacher_no, university_id, dept_id, title, research_field) values (#{userId}, #{teacherNo}, #{universityId}, #{deptId}, #{title}, #{researchField})
mapper.select: select id, user_id as userId, teacher_no as teacherNo, university_id as universityId, dept_id as deptId, title, research_field as researchField from teachers where user_id = #{userId}
select id, user_id as userId, teacher_no as teacherNo, university_id as universityId, dept_id as deptId, title, research_field as researchField from teachers where user_id = #{userId}
select id, user_id as userId, teacher_no as teacherNo, university_id as universityId, dept_id as deptId, title, research_field as researchField from teachers where id = #{id}

select t.id, t.user_id as userId, us.real_name as realName, us.phone as phone, us.avatar as avatar, us.gender as gender, us.email as email, t.teacher_no as teacherNo, t.university_id as universityId, u.name as universityName, t.dept_id as deptId, d.name as deptName, t.title as title, t.research_field as researchField from teachers t left join universities u on t.university_id = u.id left join sys_dept d on t.dept_id = d.id left join user us on t.user_id = us.id where t.user_id = #{userId}

select t.id, t.user_id as userId, us.real_name as realName, us.phone as phone, us.avatar as avatar, us.gender as gender, us.email as email, t.teacher_no as teacherNo, t.university_id as universityId, u.name as universityName, t.dept_id as deptId, d.name as deptName, t.title as title, t.research_field as researchField from teachers t left join universities u on t.university_id = u.id left join sys_dept d on t.dept_id = d.id left join user us on t.user_id = us.id
and us.real_name like concat('%', #{realName}, '%')
and t.teacher_no like concat('%', #{teacherNo}, '%')
and t.university_id = #{universityId}
and t.dept_id = #{deptId}
and t.title like concat('%', #{title}, '%')
order by t.id desc
mapper.update: update teachers set teacher_no = #{teacherNo}, university_id = #{universityId}, dept_id = #{deptId}, title = #{title}, research_field = #{researchField} where id = #{id}
